name: Olympus Rising
source:
Monsters. Gods. A secret past. When ancient threats invade your world, you discover you're the descendant of a Greek god. To survive — and uncover the truth about your mother — you must embrace your divine power. But will you?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Olympus_Rising]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
怪物。诸神。一段秘密的过去。当古老的威胁入侵你的世界时，你发现自己是希腊神的后裔。为了生存并揭开关于你母亲的真相，你必须拥抱你的神圣力量。但你会吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Olympus_Rising]Choices Wikia[/url]]
